name: Visakhapatnam

queries.query: విశాఖపట్నం పట్టణ సర్వే కాడాస్ట్రల్ మ్యాప్ భూ రికార్డులు అధికారిక
queries.scope: Find first-party district urban cadastral survey services and public parcel geometry.
queries.result: The official Visakhapatnam district Survey & Land Records page describes an urban survey program for the district, identifies the Visakhapatnam (urban) area among commissioned survey mandals, and routes document/map applications through MeeSeva with a per-square-yard fee and supporting land documents. It reports Field Measurement Book digitization progress. This is evidence of a local survey/land-record service, not an anonymous parcel-vector endpoint.
queries.executionMethod: Official district page and official Andhra Pradesh cadastral viewer page; bounded shell request to the viewer did not return within the local network timeout.

queries.query: Visakhapatnam official urban survey land records cadastral maps parcel GIS Andhra Pradesh
queries.scope: Check city GIS and state cadastral viewer for exact point lookup and full polygons.
queries.result: The Government of Andhra Pradesh BhuNaksha landing page identifies itself as the state Survey, Settlements and Land Records cadastral mapping system integrated with MeeBhoomi. The AP municipal-administration Visakhapatnam GIS page loads a general municipal map and Sachivalayam list; it does not expose cadastral parcel layers in the inspected rendered view. No WUP-point village/survey selection or full parcel polygon was verified.
queries.executionMethod: Official web search/open plus bounded direct request; no login or credentials.

registryBasis: First-party Visakhapatnam District Survey & Land Records page documents urban survey and land-record services for Visakhapatnam, including the urban mandal and map-record application workflow.
technicalBlocker: The documented local urban survey products are accessed through a document/application workflow; no public full-polygon endpoint or exact WUP-point village/survey selection was established.
remainingUncertainty: Whether Visakhapatnam urban survey maps or parcel polygons can be queried anonymously through a separate local GIS or BhuNaksha route; whether the WUP point falls in a particular survey village.
nextStep: If pursued, identify the village/survey selection for the WUP point through an official map interface and verify whether full parcel polygons can be returned without credentials; do not infer parcel coverage from the city GIS base map.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
